children: The finance director takes over from Nishant Hundiwala as the subsidiary reshuffles its senior leadership from 1 April 2027

Whirlpool of India has appointed Abhish Jain as Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of its material subsidiary, Elica India, effective 1 April 2027. Jain, who currently serves as Director – Finance at Whirlpool of India, will succeed Nishant Hundiwala, whose resignation takes effect on 31 March 2027. The change forms part of a wider leadership transition at Elica India, with Anish Ahuja set to take over as managing director from the same date.
The appointments were disclosed under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

Hundiwala has resigned from his position as CFO, citing personal reasons, according to the company’s disclosure. His tenure will conclude on 31 March 2027, with Jain assuming the role the following day.

Jain’s appointment brings a finance executive from the parent company into the subsidiary’s top finance position. He will report to Ahuja, who is currently serving as Elica India’s chief operating officer and will become managing director on 1 April 2027.

Jain is a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). His experience spans commercial finance, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), and manufacturing finance, including roles in India and international markets.

His move to Elica India follows his tenure as Director – Finance at Whirlpool of India. The company disclosure does not specify further details of his previous positions or the priorities he will pursue as CFO.

The finance transition coincides with the conclusion of Pralhad Bhutada’s employment agreement as managing director and chief executive officer of Elica India on 31 March 2027. His role and board membership will end on that date.
Ahuja, who became chief operating officer on 1 September 2026, will succeed Bhutada as managing director from 1 April 2027 and report to Elica India’s board chairman.

Ahuja has more than 32 years of experience, including over 26 years with Whirlpool of India, across sales, customer service and supply chain management. Before becoming Elica India’s COO, he served as vice-president of service at Whirlpool of India, overseeing the service profit and loss function.

The appointments mark an internal leadership transition, with Jain moving from the parent company’s finance leadership to the subsidiary as Elica India prepares for a change in its top executive role.
